locations.label: Basement power switch
locations.description: Reach Bear Lodge’s basement through the Mines and switch on power. Collect the handle against the structure near Rave Area Quickies, engine beside Mess Hall’s central pillar, and propeller upstairs in the Lodge’s Tuff ’Nuff room. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Boat boarding
locations.description: Take the film reel at the docks before boarding the repaired boathouse boat. On Turtle Island collect the reel outside the cabin’s rear door; fit both to the broken projector. Its projected wall portal reaches Pack-a-Punch during the visit window. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Projector Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Take the film reel at the docks before boarding the repaired boathouse boat. On Turtle Island collect the reel outside the cabin’s rear door; fit both to the broken projector. Its projected wall portal reaches Pack-a-Punch during the visit window. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Kevin / cabin attic
locations.description: Talk to Kevin in the cabin attic. Return by the island’s travel route when you need the main map. Prepare a weapon that removes limbs without instantly killing every target before starting the first ritual. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Vlad crossbow cabinet
locations.description: Take hot dogs from the cabin bathroom bucket. In Rave Vision, throw one at each deer head, then shoot the floating head and collect its glyph: Bear Lodge couch wall, Mess Hall fireplace and Owl Camp’s out-of-bounds cabin. Exit vision and unlock the Lodge crossbow cabinet. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Bow-statue charging speakers
locations.description: Choose the statue for your upgrade: Deer → Whirlwind EF-5, Eagle → Trap-o-Matic, Owl → Acid Rain, Wolf → Ben Franklin. Statue candidates are the obstacle course, climbing wall, Rave trailer, Mines stairs, Owl balcony, Wolf picnic table, Mess/Wolf bench, docks table and beach canoe rack. Place it on the Rave speaker stack and damage nearby zombies until enough turn to red mist; take the charged statue. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Departure buttons
locations.description: In the basement, every player uses an unlit button simultaneously. Three are beside the stairs and one by the Magic Wheel; the alarm confirms the activation. The boat now leads to the arena instead of an ordinary island visit. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
